question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"necessary"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options, **"necessary"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• In the above sentence, we use the word **"necessary" **to mean that something is needed for a purpose or a reason.
 
• Thus, ***option 1)*** is the correct alternative.&
